sources.build: STRATZ Divine-Immortal pos1, 2026-10-13 (data/meta/stratz_builds.json): Falcon Blade ~7 min, Manta Style ~17, Eye of Skadi ~28, Hurricane Pike ~29.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar (135), Bloodthorn (250), Eye of Skadi (160), Butterfly (139), Hurricane Pike (263), Hydra's Breath (1858), Daedalus (141). Recipes: OpenDota constants (Hydra's Breath and Hurricane Pike are both built from Dragon Lance).
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 109: melee (150 range); Conjure Image and Metamorphosis illusions are Terrorblade's controlled units.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-17: against illusions Butterfly, and Dragon Lance goes into Hydra's Breath instead of Hurricane Pike; Pike against heroes who jump on him; far ahead, the tempo build Manta, Skadi, Butterfly, Daedalus, then Aegis and the throne.

rules.name: Bloodthorn
rules.basis: Soul Rend silences for 5 s (no Blink, Ball Lightning...) and gives True Strike to your attacks and your controlled units' attacks on the silenced target; its passive pierces evasion on 40% of attacks. One item answers both heroes.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar
rules.basis: Pierce: 80% of attacks go through evasion with 70 magic damage, nothing to cast. Against evasion alone it is cheaper (5000 against 6400) and always on.

rules.name: Eye of Skadi
rules.basis: Eye of Skadi is in Terrorblade's usual build (~28 min) and its attacks cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s: buy it earlier rather than an off-build Spirit Vessel.

rules.name: Butterfly
rules.basis: Butterfly: 35% evasion, so about a third of the illusions' attacks miss him; it is also in his tempo build.

rules.name: Hydra's Breath
rules.basis: Hydra's Breath (Dragon Lance + Specialist's Array + Orb of Venom): 30% of ranged attacks also fire at up to 3 nearby enemies, and Miasma poisons each one hit for 2.5% of max HP per second. Terrorblade attacks from range in Metamorphosis, so the Dragon Lance goes into it instead of Hurricane Pike.

rules.name: Hurricane Pike
rules.basis: Hurricane Thrust: pushes him and the target 425 apart, then 5 attacks on it from any range with +100 attack speed for 5 s. In his STRATZ build at ~29 min.

tempo.basis: A player's GSI shows no enemy net worth; a kill lead of this size is the observed sign the enemy carry is behind. Then the counters wait: the tempo build, the Aegis and the throne.
